mechanism.claim: When funding changes across at least four of six liquid alt perpetuals share one sign while BTC funding changes in the opposite direction, broad leveraged crowding is contradicted by the BTC venue state. Fade the alt funding-acceleration majority on BTC during the next settlement interval.
mechanism.side: negative strict majority sign of the six alt funding-rate changes
mechanism.why_distinct: CAFACR uses cross-sectional changes in six realized alt funding rates plus an opposing BTC funding change. It uses no BTC price path, MFDH monotone level path, STCR trend, analog model, order flow, OI, implied volatility, or Gross9 state.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: broad cross-alt leveraged acceleration contradicted by BTC is a crowding-release mechanism; exact BTC RV20 q90 remains a later audit rather than an entry filter
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: only common funding settlements with cross-sectional acceleration contradiction qualify

features.common_settlement: all seven symbols have exactly one finite funding row at S and at the immediately preceding common settlement S-8h
features.alt_majority: at least four of six alt deltas are strictly positive or at least four are strictly negative; a 3-3 tie or all-zero majority is ineligible
features.btc_contradiction: BTC delta is nonzero and has the opposite sign to the alt majority
features.availability: both completed settlement rows must be available at S; missing, duplicate, late, non-finite, or nonconsecutive rows make S ineligible; no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.daily_return: log(C_d/C_{d-1}) assigned to UTC calendar day d
rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean(r_d^2)) over exact returns t-20 through t-1
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear 0.90 quantile over 756 available RV20 observations with decision timestamps strictly before t; current excluded
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: opened only after every full-calendar economic stage passes

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_accounting: exact realized BTC funding during [entry,exit) only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, and final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.full_calendar_decomposition: candidate net return minus comparator net return
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition restricted by causal RV20 at decision

source_plan.btc_price_or_execution: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, majority, contradiction, direction, settlement, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
